init_reasoning: The question is: "Why Chuck Schumer caught on hot mic plotting to “blame REPUBLICANS AND MAGA” for reform delays?"
init_answer:
**No, this claim is false. It stems from a manipulated video shared on social media in late February 2024, which misrepresented a real October 27, 2022, conversation between Sen. Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) and President Joe Biden at Syracuse Hancock International Airport.[[1]](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/factcheck/2024/03/05/no-schumer-didnt-discuss-blaming-republicans-on-hot-mic-fact-check/72822242007)[[2]](https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/mar/01/instagram-posts/schumer-biden-discussed-election-not-blaming-repub)**

The original video captures them speaking amid loud airplane noise, making the audio inaudible without enhancement. Fact-checkers, including USA Today, PolitiFact, Reuters, and CheckYourFact, analyzed the enhanced audio and confirmed they discussed the 2022 midterm elections—specifically, the Pennsylvania Senate race (John Fetterman's debate performance) and Georgia's Senate contest—not any "reform delays" or plans to blame Republicans or "MAGA."[[1]](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/factcheck/2024/03/05/no-schumer-didnt-discuss-blaming-republicans-on-hot-mic-fact-check/72822242007)[[2]](https://www.politifact.com/factchecks/2024/mar/01/instagram-posts/schumer-biden-discussed-election-not-blaming-repub)[[3]](https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/fake-subtitles-added-video-schumer-biden-air-base-2024-03-15)

Fake subtitles were added to the clip, falsely portraying Schumer as saying something like: "I just need more delays to show one particular donor I’m delaying reform. I know I can keep blaming Republicans and MAGA."[[3]](https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/fake-subtitles-added-video-schumer-biden-air-base-2024-03-15)[[4]](https://checkyourfact.com/2024/03/05/fact-check-chuck-schumer-caught-hot-mic-blame-maga-reform-delays) There is no evidence of Schumer "plotting" on a hot mic about blaming Republicans for any reform delays.[[4]](https://checkyourfact.com/2024/03/05/fact-check-chuck-schumer-caught-hot-mic-blame-maga-reform-delays)

Schumer has been involved in hot mic moments before (e.g., 2017 comments on Trump, 2022 midterm predictions), but none match this description.[[1]](https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/factcheck/2024/03/05/no-schumer-didnt-discuss-blaming-republicans-on-hot-mic-fact-check/72822242007)[[5]](https://www.nytimes.com/2022/10/27/us/politics/schumer-hot-mic-democrats-biden.html)

**I don’t have sufficient reliable information to confirm that.**

No credible news sources from outlets like Politifact, local Pennsylvania media (e.g., Lehigh Valley News, The Morning Call, WFMZ), or national reports verify protesters yelling "F--- Joe Biden" specifically during President Biden's arrival in Allentown, Pennsylvania. Biden visited the area on January 12, 2024, including stops in Allentown and nearby Emmaus, where some protesters were present, but reports describe general demonstrations without that exact chant.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/politifact/posts/the-audio-in-this-video-of-hecklers-yelling-profanities-at-biden-during-a-visit-/801878685306570)[[2]](https://www.lehighvalleynews.com/elections/air-force-one-lands-at-lvia-as-whirlwind-president-biden-visit-begins)

A video circulated online claiming to show such profanities during this visit, but Politifact confirmed the audio was manipulated and added, misleading viewers.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/politifact/posts/the-audio-in-this-video-of-hecklers-yelling-profanities-at-biden-during-a-visit-/801878685306570)

Protests during Biden's Pennsylvania visits have often focused on issues like U.S. policy toward Israel/Gaza (e.g., "Genocide Joe" chants) or local political opposition, but none match the described incident with high-confidence sourcing.[[3]](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2024/04/20/biden-protests-pennsylvania-election)[[4]](https://www.the-express.com/news/politics/124223/joe-biden-protesters-pennsylvania-israel-palestine)
